name: loonbids
description: Find Canadian public tenders (federal, Quebec, Toronto, Yukon, Saskatchewan), see who won similar contracts, and get email alerts for new matches, from your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription: LoonBids helps businesses find public-sector work in Canada. Ask for tenders the way you'd describe your work and LoonBids searches open notices from federal buyers, Quebec (including municipalities), Saskatchewan, Yukon and the City of Toronto, with links to each buyer's own page. Look up who won similar federal contracts, and for how much, before you bid. Save searches as email alerts; you approve each change on a card in the chat. You connect a LoonBids account the first time (a free one is enough). LoonBids is independent and isn't affiliated with any government.
defaultPrompt: Find open snow removal tenders in Ontario.
Who has won federal IT consulting contracts, and for how much?
Email me every morning about new janitorial tenders in Saskatchewan.

positive.prompt: Find open snow removal tenders in Ontario.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open snow removal notices in Ontario with buyer, closing date and a link to each notice. Asks the user to connect their LoonBids account first if they haven't.

positive.prompt: Find open snow removal tenders in Ontario, then tell me when the first one closes and who the contact is.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches, then opens the first notice and gives its closing date and time (converted from UTC), buyer, contact and documents, with a link to the buyer's page.

positive.prompt: Who has won federal grounds maintenance contracts, and for how much?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists past federal awards with supplier, value, award date and department, each linked to its award notice, and summarizes who wins most often.

positive.prompt: Email me every morning about new janitorial tenders in Saskatchewan.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews what the alert would match, checks the name, filters and daily frequency with the user, then shows an approval card. After the reviewer clicks Approve, the card confirms the new alert and the address its emails go to.

positive.description: Review alerts and fit to the company
positive.prompt: What alerts do I have, and which recent snow removal matches fit my company?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's three alerts, shows recent matches for the snow removal alert, and says which fit the company description (Ottawa area, $50,000 to $400,000 contracts).

negative.description: Submitting a bid is out of scope: LoonBids has no tool for it, so the assistant should explain that bids go through the buyer's own portal and give the notice link.
negative.prompt: Submit a bid on this tender for me.

negative.description: LoonBids covers Canadian public tenders only, so it should not be used for US contracts; if called, it finds nothing and the assistant says it covers Canada only.
Unrelated request: LoonBids should not be used at all.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Toronto tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: LoonBids does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Users can connect an existing LoonBids account, and tools only explain plan limits.

publication.release_notes: First release: search Canadian public tenders, open a tender's details, look up past federal contract awards, and manage email alerts and company info from the chat.
